readFailed: Could not read the analysis records
diagnosticOnly: AI findings are questions to review. They do not change the ontology or approve a code change.
architectureCriteria: Judge maintainability through responsibilities, dependency rules, observed violations, unknown coverage, and the evidence for each proposed improvement. A percentage without a calibrated scale is not a measurement.
agentUnavailable: Connect a supported agent in the desktop app to run an analysis. Existing Markdown records remain readable here.
agentUnavailableWithDecisions: Connect a supported agent in the desktop app to run an analysis and read meaning decisions. Existing Markdown analysis records remain readable here.
openFolder: Open your ontology folder to read its analysis history.
empty: Nothing in this scope has been analyzed yet.
emptyEffect: An analysis leaves the questions the agent raises as a Markdown record in this folder, and marks them on the map for you to review one by one.
emptyWithDecisions: Nothing in this scope has been analyzed yet, and no meaning decisions are archived.
showIssues: Show review questions on the map
overlayUnavailable: Map markers require captured evidence, the same scope, and a current basis. The original answer is still available.
issueLegend: ? marks an AI question, not a confirmed defect.
noFindings: No reviewable findings were extracted. This does not mean there are no problems.
evidenceMissing: No full-body evidence was captured for this citation.
reviewBoundary: This appends your judgment to history. Editing the ontology still follows change review.
definitionMissing: No definition is recorded here yet.
relationGuide: Read from the named subject to its target. The relationship type states the claim; the recorded reason explains why it belongs here.
rationaleMissingGroup: {count, plural, one {# connection has no recorded reason.} other {# connections have no recorded reason.}} Ask the agent to investigate before accepting an interpretation.
selectNode: Select a concept or connection on the map to inspect its meaning.
meaningPrompt: Review the business meaning in this ontology, using only Atlas reads. Read relevant definitions and boundaries with get_concepts(body: "full"). Explain missing definitions, mixed responsibilities, contradictory relations, missing rationale, and absent business rules. Distinguish recorded facts, hypotheses and unknowns. Do not modify the vault. Use exact slugs in citations.
architecturePrompt: Analyze this architecture against its recorded business responsibilities and current implementation. Read the profile and related concepts with full-body Atlas reads, then inspect the source through the supported architecture tools. Explain dependency violations, change impact, unknown coverage and concrete maintainability improvements with evidence. Do not invent a maintainability percentage. Do not modify ontology or code during this analysis.
measurementCounts: {violations} rule violations · {unmapped} unmapped dependencies · {files} files scanned
measurementScope: These counts describe the recorded scan and its declared rules. Read unknown coverage before drawing a conclusion about maintainability.
showRelationMeaning: Label relationship meanings on the map
captionGuide: Overview labels directional connections first. Select a concept or point at a connection to also read its associations. Up to 24 labels appear where they fit.
targetSelected: The target is now selected on the map.
targetSelectedSheet: The target is selected on the map. Close this panel to see it.
readCoverage: {count} full concept bodies were retained for this analysis. Other scope may remain unexamined.
earlierQuestionsNote: These questions have no dismissal in loaded history. A later empty or cancelled result does not resolve them.
targetUnavailable: This target is unavailable on the current map. Inspect its recorded evidence or run a new analysis.
fillNotes: {count, plural, one {Write # missing connection reason} other {Write # missing connection reasons}}
relationNotesPrompt: Write the missing reason behind each connection in this scope as one sentence in `relation_notes`, using Atlas tools only. For every relation whose rationale is empty: read both documents with get_concepts(body: "full"), then propose the note with patch_concept on the SOURCE document (the one whose frontmatter lists the target), passing expected_mtime and keeping every other key; write in the folder's own language. A note says why the claim holds in this codebase, never that A contains or depends on B. Where the documents give no reason, write nothing and list the pair under open questions. A `domain:` back-pointer shares its reason with the parent's containment: write it on the parent document only, never on the child. At most {limit} notes in this turn; end by saying how many remain.

meaningTransitions.title: Meaning decisions
meaningTransitions.boundary: Immutable review snapshots. Saved bytes do not authenticate a person, approve code, or prove checks, merge, or deployment.
meaningTransitions.openFolder: Open your ontology folder to read meaning decisions.
meaningTransitions.unavailable: Meaning decision history requires the desktop app on a supported computer.
meaningTransitions.empty: No meaning decision snapshots are archived in this folder.
meaningTransitions.previousNotLoaded: Load older decisions to open it
meaningTransitions.artifactsUnavailable: Retained bytes are unavailable. Read the error above before using this record.
meaningTransitions.artifactMismatch: A retained artifact no longer matches its recorded digest.
meaningTransitions.integrityBoundary: Integrity means these exact bytes reopened successfully. Authority states below remain separate supplied facts.
